prompts.name: Buildings
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel-art assets for a 2D horse farming and racing game. Input image 1 is STYLE AND SCALE REFERENCE ONLY: tiny golden horse sprites with crisp square pixels, very restrained cream/golden ochre/warm brown palette and simple readable silhouettes. Do not reproduce the sprite sheet or add horses. Match the low-resolution retro game aesthetic, orthographic near-top-down RPG view showing front faces and roofs, NOT diamond isometric. Every visible edge should be stepped pixels, small flat color clusters, no antialiasing, no smooth shading, no blur, no painterly texture, no glossy 3D, no text, no labels, no watermark. Buildings roughly 3-4 horse lengths wide. Warm ochre wood, cream plaster, muted rust roof tiles, moss and sage greens, dark warm brown shadows. Light from upper left. This is an approval preview; assets should look cohesive and functional. Create ONE transparent-background building sprite sheet with exactly THREE large separated building sprites in one horizontal row, consistent scale and baseline, generous empty space between objects, fully uncropped. LEFT: welcoming horse stable/barn, ochre timber framing, muted terracotta gabled roof, wide open dark double doorway, small cream window and horseshoe ornament, small attached side stall. MIDDLE: compact hay/feed storage shed with pitched roof, wooden side walls and a couple of neat golden hay bundles just inside the open entrance. RIGHT: small rural blacksmith workshop, stone base, timber beams, warm rust roof, short brick chimney, open front with a small anvil and a very subtle orange forge. No ground islands, no scenery, no invented signage. Entire sheet is true transparent alpha. Preserve coarse sprite-scale pixel structure instead of microdetail.
